prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic editorial of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and calm concentration. At midnight inside a high-altitude radio observatory, she fits one adult astronomer before a treaty broadcast. Bespoke tailoring connects an individual pattern, active fitting correction, hand-worked interior, and retained aftercare to this client. An individually drafted paper pattern for this same client lies open beside his half-finished charcoal jacket. Her chalk and pins mark shoulder balance and posture corrections while a turned-back lapel exposes a hand-canvassed interior and visible pad stitching. Show a basted fitting with balance corrections in progress: long white basting stitches and chalk lines on the jacket. An open repair or aftercare folder and a retained pattern record carry matching vermilion triangles visible on the pattern and jacket. In a medium-wide three-quarter view, keep both adults, the full pattern, correction, jacket interior, and records large and unobscured. Warm task lamps reveal wool, paper, basting, canvas, and pad stitches against cold starlight.
